Questions

Before you grab your seat

Is this for puppies or older dogs?

Both. The ideas work for puppies, rescues and dogs who have been with you for years.

What if I can’t make it live?

Your seat includes the replay, so you can watch it when it suits you.

Is this veterinary advice?

No. It’s an educational class about dog behaviour. If you’re worried about your dog’s health, please speak to your vet.

Why is it free?

Because the first step should be easy. Come along, learn what your dog is telling you, and decide afterwards if you want more help.

Script 1 · “Not naughty”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Your dog isn’t being naughty. Here’s what they’re actually trying to tell you.”

Body

“Barking at the door, pulling on the lead, jumping up at guests. Most of the time it’s not a dog being difficult. It’s a dog trying to cope with something. Once you can read what they’re saying, you can help them, instead of just telling them off.”

CTA

“I’m teaching exactly how in a free, live 60-minute masterclass. The replay’s included. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera with your dog beside you, captions on.

Script 2 · “The walk”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“If walks with your dog feel like a battle, watch this.”

Body

“A lot of owners think the answer is a tighter lead or a firmer voice. But a dog who pulls is often a dog who’s overwhelmed before they’ve even left the house. Change what happens in the five minutes before the walk, and the walk itself starts to change.”

CTA

“I’ll walk you through it in The Confident Dog Masterclass. Live, 60 minutes, free. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: walk-and-talk outside with your dog, cut to on-screen text “the 5 minutes before”.

Script 3 · “Raised, not born”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Confident dogs aren’t born that way. They’re raised.”

Body

“I’ve written The Dog Book and The Puppy Book, and the thing I come back to again and again is this: a confident dog is a dog who feels understood. Whether you’ve got a new puppy, a rescue, or a dog you’ve had for years, it’s never too late to start.”

CTA

“Join my free live masterclass and I’ll show you where to begin. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, hold up both books at the line about them.
